result.summary: 本论文介绍了 Llama 3 系列基础模型，包括 8B、70B 和 405B 三个参数规模的多语言语言模型，原生支持多语言、编程、推理和工具使用 [S1.p3]。最大的模型是 405B 参数的稠密 Transformer，上下文窗口最高 128K tokens [S1.p3]。论文进行了广泛的实证评估，发现 Llama 3 在大量任务上达到与 GPT-4 等领先模型相当的质量 [S1.p6]。论文还通过组合式方法将图像、视频和语音能力集成到 Llama 3 中，并观察到该方法在图像、视频和语音识别任务上与最先进水平具有竞争力 [S2.p4][S7.p2][S8.p1]。作者公开释放了 Llama 3 的预训练和后训练版本以及 Llama Guard 3 模型 [S1.p7]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在开发一套高质量的基础模型，原生支持多语言、编程、推理和工具使用 [S1.p3]。作者认为开发高质量基础模型有三个关键杠杆：数据、规模和管理复杂性，并试图在开发过程中优化这三者 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: The Llama 3 Herd of models natively supports multilinguality, coding, reasoning, and tool usage.
We believe there are three key levers in the development of high-quality foundation models: data, scale, and managing complexity.

method.text: Llama 3 采用标准的稠密 Transformer 架构，与 Llama 2 相比仅有少量修改，性能提升主要来自数据质量和多样性以及训练规模的增加 [S3.SS2.p1]。开发分为两个主要阶段：预训练阶段在大规模数据上进行下一词预测，后训练阶段通过监督微调、拒绝采样和直接偏好优化使模型对齐人类反馈 [S1.p2][S1.p5]。多模态能力通过组合式方法添加，包括训练独立的图像和语音编码器，并通过适配器将其集成到预训练语言模型中 [S2.p4][S2.p5]。

evidence.quote: Llama 3 uses a standard, dense Transformer architecture.
our performance gains are primarily driven by improvements in data quality and diversity as well as by increased training scale.

The development of modern foundation models consists of two main stages: (1) a pre-training stage in which the model is trained at massive scale using straightforward tasks such as next-word prediction or captioning and (2) a post-training stage in which the model is tuned to follow instructions, align with human preferences, and improve specific capabilities (for example, coding and reasoning).
we adopt a relatively simple post-training procedure based on supervised finetuning (SFT), rejection sampling (RS), and direct preference optimization (DPO;)
We also perform experiments in which we add image, video, and speech capabilities to Llama 3 using a compositional approach.
We train separate encoders for images and speech.

experiments.text: 论文在大量标准基准上评估了预训练和后训练模型，覆盖常识推理、知识、阅读理解、数学推理、长上下文、代码、对抗评估和聚合评估等类别 [S5.SS1.SSS1.p1]。此外还进行了广泛的人类评估，比较 Llama 3 与竞争模型 [S1.p6]。多模态实验在图像识别、视频识别和语音理解任务上进行了评估 [S7.SS6.p1][S7.SS7.p1][S8.SS4.p1]。

evidence.quote: These evaluations cover eight top-level categories: (1) commonsense reasoning; (2) knowledge; (3) reading comprehension; (4) math, reasoning, and problem solving; (5) long context; (6) code; (7) adversarial evaluations; and (8) aggregate evaluations.
In addition, we perform extensive human evaluations that compare Llama 3 with competing models.

We evaluate the performance of the image understanding capabilities of Llama 3 on a range of tasks spanning natural image understanding, text understanding, charts understanding and multimodal reasoning
We evaluate our video adapter for Llama 3 on three benchmarks
We evaluate the speech understanding capabilities of our speech interface for Llama 3 on three tasks: (1) automatic speech recognition, (2) speech translation, and (3) spoken question answering.

findings.text: 实验评估表明，旗舰模型在多种任务上与 GPT-4 等领先语言模型表现相当，并接近最先进水平 [S1.p6]。较小的模型是同类最佳，优于参数数量相近的替代模型 [S1.p6]。Llama 3 在有用性和无害性之间实现了比前代更好的平衡 [S1.p6]。多模态实验产生的模型能够识别图像和视频内容，并支持通过语音界面交互 [S2.p6]。

evidence.quote: Our experimental evaluation suggests that our flagship model performs on par with leading language models such as GPT-4 across a variety of tasks, and is close to matching the state-of-the-art.
Our smaller models are best-in-class, outperforming alternative models with similar numbers of parameters.
Llama 3 also delivers a much better balance between helpfulness and harmlessness than its predecessor.
Our multimodal experiments lead to models that can recognize the content of images and videos, and support interaction via a speech interface.

limitations.text: 多模态模型仍在积极开发中，尚未准备好发布 [S1.p8][S2.p6]。作者承认，没有任何测试能保证穷尽所有可能的风险，Llama 3 仍可能生成有害内容，尤其是在英语之外的语言中，或被熟练的对抗性红队人员通过提示工程诱导 [S5.SS4.SSS8.p1]。恶意开发者或对抗性用户可能找到新的越狱方法 [S5.SS4.SSS8.p1]。人类评估可能受标注者个人偏见、背景和偏好的影响，导致结果不一致或不可靠 [S5.SS3.p5]。

evidence.quote: These models are still under active development and not yet ready for release.
These models are still under development and not yet ready for release.
no testing can be guaranteed to be exhaustive in identifying every possible risk.
Llama 3 may still generate harmful content due to training on various datasets, particularly for languages beyond English and when prompt engineered by skilled adversarial red teamers.
Malicious developers or adversarial users may find new ways to jailbreak our models and use them for various nefarious usecases.
human evaluations can still be influenced by personal biases, backgrounds, and preferences of human annotators, which may lead to inconsistent or unreliable results.
